items.title: 入境處與深圳邊檢總站於香園圍管制站進行APEC應練
items.summary: 入境處表示，為切實執行APEC會議安保任務，聯同深圳邊檢總站昨日在香園圍管制站開展「APEC安保粵港口岸聯動應急處置演練」。 入境處處長郭俊峯率領管制部人員到場，與深圳邊檢總站總站長徐曉偉等領導一同指導今次演練。演練著重提升一線人員維護粵港口岸邊檢安全的意識，以及應對突發事件的即時應變能力。…

items.title: 李家超稱五年規劃高度重視北都發展 大學城將促進學術與產業聯繫
items.summary: 行政長官李家超出席邵逸夫獎頒獎禮致辭時指出，香港首個「五年規劃」高度重視發展北部都會區，正建設三個大學城。 他指出，三個大學城分別包括聚焦發展醫學、生命健康科技及人工智能等，並推動智能製造應用型專上教育及培育國際化人才，另外亦將融入藝術及藍綠發展元素。 李家超說，大學城將吸引各地學者、學生及跨學科研究機構，促進學術與產業等連繫。他又說，政府相信未來將以科學為核心，知識會帶來回報。 編輯：任順熙

items.title: 食環署打擊冷氣機滴水首9個月發逾8千張通知 稱AI識別助執法
items.summary: 食環署總結今年打擊冷氣機滴水工作時指出，至9月底累計發出約8100張「妨擾事故通知」，較去年及前年分別增加約16%及54%，亦是2023同期約四倍。署方指，超過99%收到通知的住戶已處理滴水問題。 署方亦指，近年重點跟進各區約300個冷氣機滴水問題較嚴重的關注地點，包括巴士站、小巴站及行人通道等，並每周巡查最少一次。截至8月，約一半關注地點滴水問題已解決或明顯改善。而截至9月底，關注地點由約300個增至400多個。…
items.titleEn: The Food and Drug Administration has issued more than 8,000 notices for nine months that AI identifies and helps enforce the law
items.summaryEn: The Food and Drug Administration summarized the work of the cold-gas drip machine this year, noting that about 8,100 "disruptive accident notifications" had been issued by the end of September, an increase of about 16% and 54%, respectively, compared to last year and last year, and about four times the same period in 2023. According to the report, more than 99% of the households who received the notification had already dealt with the issue of drops. The agency also noted that in recent years, it has been focused on monitoring around 300 hot air balloon drop water issues in areas of greater concern, including bus stations, minibus stations and pedestrian corridors, and inspecting them at least once a week. As of August, about half of the water drop problem at the sites of concern has been resolved or significantly improved. In the end of September, the number of focused sites increased from about 300 to over 400. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 衞生署：75個新冠疫苗接種點已足夠應付目前接種需求
items.summary: 衞生署發言人表示，整體接種新冠疫苗初始劑次人士比率超過九成，又指新冠疫苗加強劑接種率計算有別於其他疫苗，需要考慮相關群組人士最近有否感染新冠病毒及其感染日期。 發言人說，根據現行接種計劃，優先組別人士若已完成初始劑次，不論過往已接種多少劑疫苗，在接種上一劑疫苗或感染新冠病毒至少180日後，可免費接種加強劑。由於目前未有相關群組人士感染新冠病毒的完整數據，未能計算群組疫苗接種率。…
items.titleEn: Around 75 new coronavirus vaccines have been given enough to meet the current vaccine demand
items.summaryEn: A spokesperson for the National Health Service said that the overall rate of initial vaccination of people with the new coronavirus vaccine is over 90%, and that the new coronavirus vaccination booster doses are calculated differently from other vaccines and that it is necessary to consider whether the relevant groups have recently been infected with the coronavirus and their date of infection. According to the spokesperson, according to the current vaccination program, people in priority groups who have completed their initial doses, regardless of how many doses have been vaccinated in the past, can receive a free booster vaccine at least 180 days after the first dose or infection with the novel coronavirus. As there are currently no complete data on new coronavirus infections among the relevant groups, it is not possible to calculate the vaccination rate of the group. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 本港暫停英國林肯郡爆發禽流感地區的禽肉及禽類產品進口
items.summary: 食物安全中心宣布，因應世界動物衞生組織通報，指英國林肯郡North Lincolnshire爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感，中心即時指示業界暫停由該地區進口禽肉及禽類產品包括禽蛋。 中心發言人說，根據政府統計處資料，本港今年首9個月由英國進口約680公噸冰鮮和冷藏禽肉及約22萬隻禽蛋。 發言人指，中心已就事件聯絡英國當局，會繼續密切留意，因應當地疫情發展採取適當行動。 編輯：任順熙
items.titleEn: HQ suspends imports of poultry meat and poultry products from the poultry flu outbreak in Lincolnshire, UK
items.summaryEn: The Centre for Food Safety announced that, in response to a report by the World Wildlife Fund (WWFW) that there was an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in North Lincolnshire, England, the Centre immediately instructed the industry to suspend imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including poultry eggs, from the region. A central spokesman said that according to government statistics, Hong Kong imported about 680 tonnes of frozen and chilled poultry meat and about 220,000 poultry eggs from the UK in the first nine months of this year. A spokesman said the Centre has contacted the UK authorities about the incident and will continue to monitor closely as appropriate action is taken as the epidemic develops locally. Editor's note: This is a great book.

items.titleEn: Sun Yat-sen has said that the land has been banned for more than three months, and that he has inspected 7,300 properties and imposed a fine of 84.
items.summaryEn: The Director of the Bureau of Labor and Welfare, Sun Yue, said that the government officially imposed a total ban on smoking on the land on July 17th, and that as of the end of October, the Bureau of Labour had inspected 7,300 land areas, issued 84 "notifying fines" to illegal smokers, and issued five stamps to the landlord in four cases. In a speech at an event, Sun Yu said that some of the 7,300 sites inspected were built based on citizen complaints, but most were strike inspections by the Labor Department. Of the 84 "fixed penalty notices" issued, 28 were based on citizen complaints, most of which were accompanied by photos or even videos. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 北環綫項目為港鐵工程造價最高項目 日後不排除發債以外方式融資
items.summary: 港鐵表示，北環綫項目建造成本預算為862億元，是港鐵工程中造價最高的項目，近年港鐵有透過發債，增加現金流，強調這幾年的財政狀況穩健，日後不排除會以發債以外的方式融資。 至於政府以「鐵路加物業」模式批出的8幅土地，部分的收地工作仍在進行，需要等待相關的收地程序完成。至於批出土地的先後次序，需要由政府決定。 港鐵又表示，北環綫整條走綫採用地底設計，已減省收地程序所需時間，以及考慮到保育等因素。 編輯：任順熙
